# QUOTATION

## Syntax

```synesis
FIELD <name> TYPE QUOTATION
    SCOPE <scope>
    [DESCRIPTION <text>]
    [GUIDELINES ... END GUIDELINES]
    [CONTEXT FROM DATASET <section>]
END FIELD
```

`[ ]` optional · `<>` value to replace

## Example

```synesis
FIELD example_quotation TYPE QUOTATION
    SCOPE ITEM
END FIELD
```
